description_for_human: Discover and interact with the MegaChad burn-to-create engine and MEGA Protocol DeFi stack on MegaETH. Returns ready-to-sign calldata for every action.
description_for_model: MegaChad is an on-chain protocol on MegaETH (chain 4326) with two tokens — $MEGACHAD (burn token) and $MEGAGOONER (governance/reward) — and a full DeFi stack: MoggerStaking, JESTERGOONER V4 (LP staking), MegaChadLP MC/MG AMM, EmissionController, Jestermogger governance, NFTVetoCouncil, Framemogger, CircuitBreaker. Use the natural-language endpoint at /api/agent/chat for the simplest experience, or call individual builders at /api/defi/* for stake/unstake/claim/swap/add-liquidity/vote/queue/execute/propose/veto. Pull /.well-known/megachad-protocol.json once for the canonical contract registry. KEY GOTCHA: MegaChadLP uses tokenA/tokenB instead of token0/token1 — standard V2 routers will NOT detect it; always use /api/defi/amm/quote and /api/defi/amm/swap-tx instead.
